description: Ministry of Education - Universities Act,No 16 of 1978 Degree Awarding Institute Order
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the issuance of a legal/regulatory order under the Universities Act, amending degree program requirements and entry qualifications for a specific educational institution. It constitutes a regulatory framework for higher education accreditation and compliance, falling under Legal/Regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
